items.topic: A1. Chinese EMS published price per through-hole joint (selective / wave / hand / 插件)

findings.unit: CNY per through-hole joint (插件焊点)
findings.conditions: Huaqiu SMT online valuation page, standard rate table; 插件焊点数 = pad count of all through-hole packages in the BOM; soldering method not named (selective vs wave vs hand not separated). Prices subject to customer-service confirmation.
findings.source: Huaqiu (华秋智造) SMT online valuation
findings.quote: 收费标准： 贴片：￥0.01/焊点 插件：￥0.10/焊点 X-ray：￥3.00/元件 钢网：￥100/印刷面 拆板费：￥0.50/PCB … 插件焊点数： BOM清单中所有插件封装的物料焊盘个数 … 备：因材料及工艺不同，具体价格以下单后客服的报价为准
findings.translation: Rate card: SMT ¥0.01/joint; through-hole ¥0.10/joint; X-ray ¥3.00/component; stencil ¥100/printed side; depanel ¥0.50/PCB … THT joint count = number of pads of all through-hole packages in the BOM … Note: price depends on material and process; final price is the customer-service quote after ordering.
findings.comparatorSmt: ¥0.01 per SMT joint on the same page

findings.unit: CNY per joint (hand soldering, 手工焊接) + CNY 20 engineering fee per order
findings.conditions: JLC (嘉立创) hand-soldering service; page created 2020-12-01, updated 2026-03-03. Same page: SMT 0.01 CNY/joint + 50 CNY engineering fee.
findings.source: JLC 嘉立创 service guide
findings.quote: 手工焊接收费方式： 工程费：20元 + 焊接费：0.2元每个焊点 … 贴片收费方式：工程费：50元+焊点费 + 0.01元每个焊点
findings.translation: Hand soldering charge: engineering fee CNY 20 + soldering fee CNY 0.2 per joint … SMT placement charge: engineering fee CNY 50 + CNY 0.01 per joint

findings.unit: USD per manually soldered joint (THT 'manual assembly'), 1–10,000 joints
findings.conditions: JLCPCB global price page, last updated Oct 22 2026; tiers 10,001–30,000 joints $0.015; 30,001–100,000 joints $0.012; plus hand-soldering labor $3.58 per order. Same for Economic and Standard PCBA.
findings.source: JLCPCB — What does your PCB assembly price include?
findings.quote: 1–10,000 joints: $0.0164/joint; 10,001–30,000 joints: $0.015/joint; 30,001–100,000 joints: $0.012/joint; Hand-soldering Labor $3.58 per order; 'The fee is calculated based on the number of solder joints requiring manual soldering.' Last updated on Oct 22, 2026

findings.unit: USD per joint for parts marked 'wave soldering' (assembled manually) + USD 3.5 per order
findings.conditions: JLCPCB PCB assembly FAQ, last updated Sep 09 2026 (older figure than the Oct 2026 price page).
findings.source: JLCPCB PCB assembly FAQs
findings.quote: Now JLCPCB can support through-hole components by offering wave soldering services, like connectors. … The part's assembly type marked with "wave soldering" in our assembly parts library will be assembled manually. … Cost: $3.5 hand-soldering labor fee + $0.0173 manual assembly fee per joint.

findings.unit: CNY per point (后焊插件, post/hand soldered through-hole, 1 joint = 1 point)
findings.conditions: Above the sample threshold; small-batch sample fee 200–600 CNY. Large pads counted 2–3 points. Page dated 2016-09-27 (10 years old).
findings.source: 深圳板朗科技 (Shenzhen Banglang) PCBA加工收费标准
findings.quote: 后焊插件收费标准 小批量插件后悔收取200-600元不等的打样费，超过打样标准按0.04元/点计算。 注：一个角算一个点，一般焊盘较大的一个点这算为2-3个点。 … 插件及后焊元件按一个焊点为一点计算。 … 时间：2016-09-27
findings.translation: Post-solder through-hole charge: small batches pay a sample fee of 200–600 CNY; above the sample threshold 0.04 CNY/point. Note: one lead = one point; a large pad counts as 2–3 points. … Through-hole and post-soldered parts are counted one joint = one point. … Date: 2016-09-27

findings.unit: process statement (no price)
findings.conditions: JLC states its through-hole soldering is done by selective wave soldering; its SMT price is 1 fen per joint; plug-in (插装件) parts are excluded from the SMT price cut.
findings.source: JLC 嘉立创 SMT site + 焊点超低价说明
findings.quote: 插件焊接 选择性波峰焊可对每一个焊点的焊接参数进行设置 … 注：非嘉立创EDA设计的产品、插装件、插装改贴装件、邮寄到嘉立创的元器件（不管来源），暂不在降价范围内。（创建时间：2024-03-12 更新时间：2025-04-23）
findings.translation: Through-hole soldering: selective wave soldering lets the parameters of every joint be set … Note: products not designed in JLC EDA, through-hole parts, … are not in the price reduction.

findings.unit: rule (no figure)
findings.conditions: Huaqiu notice effective 2023-07-20: DIP (through-hole) soldering priced per joint again, customer no longer pays the wave-solder fixture fee.
findings.source: 华秋SMT计价方式调整通知函
findings.quote: 本次计价调整于2023年7月20日起实施 … DIP焊接计价调整，计价方式回归按照焊点单价计算，不再涉及由客户承担治波峰具费用；
findings.translation: This pricing change takes effect 20 Jul 2023 … DIP soldering pricing returns to a per-joint unit price; the customer no longer bears the wave-solder fixture cost.

findings.unit: points per DIP lead (counting rule)
findings.conditions: Shenzhen JC (捷创) blog, updated 2025-07-29; marketing article, no price for DIP given on this page.
findings.source: 捷创电子 PCBA加工费用如何计算
findings.quote: 通常一个SMT焊盘算1个点，一个DIP引脚算1.5-2个点。
findings.translation: Usually one SMT pad counts as 1 point, one DIP lead counts as 1.5–2 points.

items.notFound: No Chinese EMS page read that publishes a SEPARATE per-joint price for 选择焊/选择性波峰焊 versus 波峰焊. Huaqiu (插件 ¥0.10/joint) and JLC (selective wave is its through-hole process; hand 0.2 CNY/joint) do not split by method. Ordinary wave-solder per-joint price: not read on any page (a 2018 Zhihu post said to give 波峰焊 0.02 / 手焊 0.03 元/焊点 returned 403 — NOT recorded). Nodpcba (诺的电子) pages said by search snippets to give 插件焊点 0.045元 (incl. 13% VAT) and 后焊 0.03–0.08元/焊点 could not be read (HTTP 503 / expired TLS certificate) — NOT recorded. No page states prices at 10k–250k boards/yr volume; all lists are prototype / small-batch web rate cards.

items.topic: A2. Selective soldering machine cycle data (s per joint, dip / drag)

findings.unit: min per board cycle (single-nozzle miniwave, joints soldered one after another)
findings.conditions: SEHO design guideline; versus multi-nozzle dip tool 20–40 s per cycle (all joints at once, product-specific nozzle tool). Based on realised projects; no date on the extracted text.
findings.source: SEHO 'Recommendations for the Design of Assemblies to be Soldered Selectively' (hosted by distributor VR Elektronika)
findings.quote: miniwave soldering with single nozzle • all solder joints are approached successively • cycle time: approx. 1 min–10 min depending on the number of joints • high flexibility – long cycle time | miniwave dip soldering with multi-nozzle tool • all solder joints are processed simultaneously • product-specific nozzle tool • cycle time: approx. 20–40 sec. • low flexibility – short cycle time

findings.unit: s per assembly (multiwave dip, soldering step only)
findings.conditions: Ersa (Kurtz Ersa) selective soldering product overview; soldering tool made specifically for each product.
findings.source: Ersa Selective Soldering Product Overview (en)
findings.quote: In high-volume production, simultaneous selective soldering processes are necessary in order to meet the cycle times required. Multiwave soldering technology enables all solder joints on an assembly to be soldered in a single operation, achieving very short soldering times of two to three seconds. The soldering tool is manufactured specifically for each product.

findings.unit: s soldering time for an 84-joint test board, drag over selective wave at 25 mm/s
findings.conditions: Vitronics Soltec (G. Diepstraten) study, Circuits Assembly Dec 2002. Same board: multiwave dip 27.4 s (SnPb); lead-free dip cycle 36 s (30 s preheat + 6 s conveyor); wave solder cycle 16.5 s (20 mm/s conveyor, 160 mm gap); hand soldering 2.7 s/joint SnPb, 3.5 s/joint lead-free. Arithmetic of the quoted figures (not stated in the article): 59.3/84 = 0.71 s per joint drag; hand 84 × 3.5 = 294 s. Old (2002) machine generation.
findings.source: Circuits Assembly, Dec 2002, 'Defining the Correct Soldering Process' (Vitronics Soltec)
findings.quote: The test board contained 84 through-hole joints to be soldered (Figure 2). The average soldering time in hand soldering is 2.7 seconds. … lead-free alloys are harder to solder by hand, resulting in an increase of the solder time to 3.5 seconds. … For dragging over the selective wave, 59.3 seconds is required, and, for dipping on the multiwave, 27.4 seconds is needed. In the lead-free process, the solder time is still 59.3 seconds for the selective wave, since the assembly is soldered with the same speed (25 mm/sec.). For dip soldering … resulting in a 36-second cycle time (30 seconds of preheat, plus 6 seconds of conveyor time). … The conveyor speed during the soldering of the assembly is 20 mm/sec. (120 cm/min.). Leaving a space of 160 mm between each board results in a cycle time of 16.5 seconds in one wave soldering machine

findings.unit: process parameters
findings.conditions: Vitronics Soltec (G. Diepstraten), Circuits Assembly Sep 2002, Part 1 of 3. Drag: 275–300 °C, drag speed 10–25 mm/s. Multidip: dip speed 20–25 mm/s, dip time typically 1–3 s, speed after dip typically 2 mm/s.
findings.source: Circuits Assembly, Sep 2002, 'Making Selective Soldering Work for You'
findings.quote: With drag soldering, the following parameter settings may be used: • solder temperature of 275°C to 300°C • drag speed of 10 to 25 mm/s • tilting angle, typically 10° … With dip soldering, the following parameter settings may be used: … • dip speed of 20 to 25 mm/s • pump frequency, depends on number of nozzles • dip time, typically 1 to 3 sec • speed after dip, typically 2 mm/s.

findings.unit: solder connections per second (multi-dip, 300 connections in 30 s)
findings.conditions: Vitronics Soltec (G. Diepstraten), SMTA paper: 32 shavers in one dip. High-volume consumer case, many identical small boards in one dip.
findings.source: 'Reliable Selective Soldering for High Volume Assemblies' (smtnet library)
findings.quote: Selective dip soldering is a robot controlled soldering process that could solder 32 shavers in one dip. In other words 300 solder connections in a cycle time of 30 seconds; equals 10 solder connections per second 24 hours a day; being 30 times faster than hand soldering.

findings.unit: s dipping time, absolute maximum
findings.conditions: Vitronics Soltec (G. Diepstraten) IPC paper; experiments at drag speeds 2 and 3 mm/s; average contact time 3.6 s (8 mm wettable) vs 2.3 s (6 mm non-wettable nozzle).
findings.source: IPC APEX paper 'Design Improvements for Selective Soldering Assemblies'
findings.quote: A dipping time of 5 to 10 seconds is absolutely the maximum for this application. Longer dipping times will not improve the through-hole filling and will only damage the assembly materials. … In this experiment, 2 and 3 mm/s. were compared. … The average contact time is 3.6 seconds versus 2.3 seconds for

items.notFound: No maker data sheet read that states 'seconds per joint' or 'joints per hour' for ERSA VERSAFLOW / ECOSELECT, Pillarhouse, SEHO, Ebso or Kurtz machines — makers quote per-assembly cycle times and parameters (drag speed, dip time). Figures such as '1 s per joint' (Wikipedia, citation needed) and '2.5–4 s per joint' / '3–8 joints per second' (blogs: electricalflux.com, huaxingpcba.com) were seen only in search summaries from non-maker sites and NOT recorded. SEHO SmartSplit article (smta.org) returned 403.

items.topic: A3. Selective / wave solder pallet (fixture) price per design

findings.unit: USD per wave-solder pallet (carrier)
findings.conditions: Vitronics Soltec 2002; pallet life ~20,000 cycles; average handling time per pallet ~20 s; a minimum number of carriers is needed per assembly. WAVE pallet, not a selective pallet.
findings.source: Circuits Assembly, Dec 2002 (Vitronics Soltec)
findings.quote: The lifetime of the carrier is also limited to approximately 20,000 cycles. Good pallets, depending on design and size, cost $200 to $1,000 each. The average handling time of a pallet is approximately 20 seconds.

findings.unit: CNY per set, synthetic-stone (合成石) wave-solder fixture, ≥30 pcs
findings.conditions: Dongguan fixture maker, page dated 2016-09-09; also FR4 glass-fibre 50–450 CNY/set and titanium 500–3000 CNY/set (≥30 pcs). Wave fixtures, not selective.
findings.source: 东莞市赐宏智能设备制造有限公司 — 波峰焊治具多少钱一个
findings.quote: 玻纤板波峰焊治具价格：数量在30个以上的价格范围：50-450元之间一套。 合成石波峰焊治具价格：数量在30个以上的价格范围：80-1000元之间一套。 钛合金波峰焊治具价格：数量在30个以上的价格范围：500-3000元之间一套。（日期:16-09-09）
findings.translation: FR4 wave fixture: qty ≥30, 50–450 CNY per set. Synthetic-stone wave fixture: qty ≥30, 80–1000 CNY per set. Titanium wave fixture: qty ≥30, 500–3000 CNY per set. (Date 2016-09-09)

items.notFound: No page read that publishes a price for a SELECTIVE-solder pallet / carrier (选择焊治具 / 选择性波峰焊载具). Huaqiu's 2023 notice says the customer no longer pays the wave fixture fee (no figure). Selective nozzle / multiwave nozzle-plate prices: not found.

items.topic: B2. Dispensing machine speed (dots per hour / s per dot)

findings.unit: dots per hour (DPH), single valve
findings.conditions: Nordson ASYMTEK Vantage Series data sheet, July 2026 (hosted on components101.com). Dual valve: ≥45,000 DPH per valve. Platform carries DispenseJet DJ-9500 jet; 'micro-dot jetting up to 1,000 Hz'. Accuracy footnotes verified on a 722-dot grid — the DPH is a jetted-dot X-Y placement rating; a staking bead of RTV with a needle/auger valve is slower and is not covered by this figure.
findings.source: Nordson ASYMTEK Vantage Series data sheet
findings.quote: Wet Dispense X-Y Placement Accuracy and Repeatability: Single valve 49,000 DPH (4) … Dual valve ≥ 45,000 DPH (4) per valve … (4) DPH: Dots Per Hour. … micro-dot jetting up to 1,000 Hz

items.notFound: No maker data read for seconds per staking dot / bead with a needle (time-pressure, auger or volumetric) valve, which is what silicone staking and corner bond use. Musashi (ML-5000XII), GPD Global and Axxon (Mycronic) publish no dots-per-hour figure on pages found; an Axxon Ai800 '1,000 dots per second' figure and a Spectrum II '30,000 dots/hr' figure appeared only in search summaries of press items (not read on page) and were NOT recorded. Mycronic MY700JX (>1 M dots/h) is solder-paste jet printing, not staking.

notes: Only values read on the page are recorded; 'dateRead' is 2026-11-25 for all. Derived per-joint / per-kg figures are labelled as arithmetic on the quoted numbers, not page values. Key gaps: (1) no Chinese EMS publishes a selective-solder (选择焊) per-joint price separate from wave / hand; Huaqiu prices all through-hole joints at CNY 0.10 and JLC (which says its through-hole is selective wave) prices hand soldering at CNY 0.2/joint and global manual assembly at USD 0.012–0.0164/joint; these are web prototype / small-batch rate cards, not 10k–250k/yr contract prices. (2) No maker 'seconds per joint' spec; best maker evidence is per-board: 84 joints dragged in 59.3 s at 25 mm/s (Vitronics 2002, ~0.7 s/joint by arithmetic), multiwave dip 2–3 s soldering (Ersa) / 20–40 s cycle (SEHO), single-nozzle 1–10 min (SEHO); hand 2.7–3.5 s/joint (Vitronics). (3) No selective pallet price; wave pallets USD 200–1,000 (2002) / CNY 80–1,000 synthetic stone (2016). (4) No Chinese 点胶 / 灌胶 price per point / gram / ml; only JLC coating (CNY 0.03/cm² + 40/60 per order) and a blog's CNY 100–300 per board for potting. (5) Dispenser DPH found only for Nordson Vantage jetting (49k DPH), not for needle staking. Several Chinese EMS pages failed (nodpcba.com expired TLS cert / 503; zhihu 403; bbs.huaqiu.com 404).
